1 This is an application filed by the appellants praying for condoning the delay of 2407 days in filing the appeal.
2. The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
3. The petitioners filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal related to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 2407 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
4. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioners will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
Post after two months for settlement.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE SMA 07-02-2025 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Joy vs Libin Paul on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122764429/
